notes: Research-based; no hands-on claims. WebFetch could not reach any site this session, so specs come from search-result summaries of the listed pages; please spot-check. Rogue Fab deformation figures (5.5-11% rotary draw, 1.8-2.5% mandrel, 0.9% on a 2.75 in 1D bend) are labelled as the maker's own. (2) Vibrant 12609 radius (4.25 in) and legs (5/8/12 in) come from a dealer table (Verocious) and a matching JEGS listing, not Vibrant's own page; the box says so. (3) KAKA EPB-3: listings disagree on 220 V vs 240 V (flagged). A used-equipment listing claimed 0-180 deg and a 12-gauge wall rating; left out because no current spec sheet confirmed them. (4) Stainless Headers' 1/4 in trim allowance is from the research fact-check notes (J-bend optimiser), not re-checked this session. (5) The 2.5 in x .065 in wall-ratio figure (about 38) and the 3.75 in CLR / 5.89 in arc example are plain geometry.
